_source: ElectionGuard v2.0 additive-homomorphic ElGamal tally model (github.com/microsoft/electionguard).
_framing: INTEROP SANITY CHECK, NOT CONFORMANCE. ElectionGuard uses integer ElGamal modulo a large prime p; Saksi uses ristretto255 elliptic-curve ElGamal. Ciphertext bytes, nonces, and proof systems therefore differ and are NOT comparable. What is pinned here is the plaintext tally SEMANTICS that both exponential-ElGamal voting schemes must agree on: encrypt each {0,1} selection, homomorphically add the ciphertexts, threshold/secret decrypt, and recover the SAME per-selection totals. Each ballot is a single-choice contest (exactly one selection = 1), mirroring ElectionGuard's in-range selection model.
